enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.hint: Off leaves the journal exactly as Foundry has it: the Journal button opens the Journal tab, and nothing of the module's is drawn.

classic.name: Classic Mode
classic.hint: On this client, the Journal button opens Foundry's own Journal tab instead of Handouts. The Handouts window has a Classic Mode button, and the Journal tab a Handouts button to come back.

showKeeps.name: Show keeps it visible
showKeeps.hint: When the GM shows a page, it is also made visible to the players it was shown to, so they can open it again from their Handouts. Off: Show only flashes it, and who can open the page is left as it is. The Show options choose either way each time.

assetFolders.name: Asset folders
assetFolders.hint: Where Not in a journal looks for pictures no journal page uses yet: folders relative to Data, one per line or separated by commas. Blank: the world's assets/handouts, assets/journal, assets/maps and assets/portraits.

handoutsJournal.name: Handouts journal
handoutsJournal.hint: The journal Add to the Handouts journal puts a picture in, made on first use (GM only).

finder.name: Find a handout
finder.hint: Opens the finder: type a word, pick with the arrows, Enter shows it to everyone (a player's Enter opens it).

search.label: Search handouts
search.more: {n} more outside this view: search everything

classic.hint: Foundry's own journal, on this client. The Journal tab then has a Handouts button to come back.
classic.on: Classic Mode: the Journal button opens Foundry's own journal on this client. Its Handouts button brings this window back.

count.matchingFiles: {pages}, plus {files} not in a journal, matching “{q}”

show.revealedFinder: “{name}” is now visible to all players. Undo is at the top of the Handouts window.
show.undoHint: Put who can open it back as it was before the Show (the popout already on their screens stays)
show.undone: {name} is back as it was before the Show.
show.pictureHint: Show only the page's picture, as an image popout; who can open the page is left as it is
show.nobodyOnline: No player is connected to see {name} now.
show.notOwner: Only an owner of the page can show it.

hint.reveal: Make it visible to every player, then show it to everyone connected
hint.add: Add it to the Handouts journal, visible to every player, and show it to everyone connected

show.undoChanged: {name} has changed since the Show, so it was left as it is now.

error.show: Showing {name} failed; the console has the reason.
error.write: That change could not be written; the console has the reason.

empty.search: Nothing here matches. Try a file name, a section or a word from the text.

gm.all: This world has no journal pages yet.
gm.visible: No page is visible to the players yet. Show one, or light a player under Players can see.
gm.gm: Every page is visible to the players.
gm.recent: Nothing shown from this browser yet.
gm.pinned: Nothing pinned. Drag a card here, or press Pin in its panel.
gm.loose: Every picture in the asset folders is in a journal.

player.recent: Nothing shown to you yet. What the GM shows you lands here.
player.all: Nothing here yet. What the GM shows you lands here.

detail.fileNote: A picture not in a journal: no player can open it again until it is added to the Handouts journal. Show still sends it as an image popout.
detail.noPlayers: This world has no players yet.
detail.canSeeNote: Highlighted players can open it again from their Handouts.
detail.fileLine: A picture not in a journal yet

pin.hint: Pinned handouts are kept in this browser, for the next session's shortlist.

keep.hint: Make it an image page in the Handouts journal, GM only until shown
keep.done: {name} is a page in {journal} now, GM only until shown.

opts.keepFile: Add it to the Handouts journal
opts.keepOn: They can open it again from their Handouts.
opts.keepOff: They see it now; who can open it later is left as it is.
opts.keepFileOn: An image page is made in the Handouts journal, visible to them.
opts.keepFileOff: An image popout only: no page, nothing written.
opts.title: Title on the popout
opts.caption: Caption
opts.nobody: Pick at least one player, or Everyone.

finder.title: Find a handout
finder.placeholder: A name, a section, a file, a word from the text
finder.placeholderPlayer: Search what you have been given
finder.none: Nothing by that name, section, file or word.
finder.empty: Type to search. Pinned and recently shown handouts appear here.
